referenceImageName.description: Reference another imageRefs key as input for image generation. Sugar for references[0].name

referenceImage.description: Direct source (path/url/base64) as reference image for generation. Sugar for references[0].source

references.description: Reference images (by imageRefs key or direct source) with optional role labels

name.description: An imageRefs key to use as a reference image

source.description: Direct source (path/url) to use as a reference image

label.description: Role of this reference (e.g. 'the firefighter Travis Kane'), injected into the prompt as a preamble

imageName.description: Reference an imageRefs key to use as image-to-video input

fillOption.description: How to handle aspect ratio differences between image and canvas

firstFrameImageName.description: Reference an imageRefs key for the first frame (image-to-video input), or '$beatImage' for the beat's own generated image

lastFrameImageName.description: Reference an imageRefs key for the last frame (image-to-video interpolation), or '$beatImage' for the beat's own generated image

frameFillColor.description: Fill color used when padding firstFrame/lastFrame reference images to the canvas aspect ratio (e.g. '#F7F6F4'). Default: black

referenceImages.description: Style/asset reference images (Veo 3.1). Mutually exclusive with imageName/lastFrameImageName

generateAudio.description: Request audio generation in the video (model-dependent)

x.description: Horizontal centre of the avatar, % of the canvas width. Default 84%

y.description: Bottom edge of the avatar, % of the canvas height. Default 100%

scale.description: Height of the avatar, % of the canvas height. Default 62%

emotion.description: The avatar's expression during this beat

motion.description: Motion name, e.g. nod, tilt, think, giggle, surprise

at.description: Words of the beat's text where the motion starts. Default: the start of the beat

hidden.description: Hide the speaker's avatar during this beat

brief.description: Whole-video art direction shared by every remotion beat (palette, type, mood), so all scenes look like one film.

introPadding.description: Padding at the beginning of the audio

closingPadding.description: Padding before the last beat (typically the closing credit). For padding after the last beat, use outroPadding

outroPadding.description: Padding after the last beat, at the very end of the audio where the BGM fades out (distinct from closingPadding, which comes before the last beat)

movieVolume.description: Default movie audio volume for all beats

ttsVolume.description: TTS narration volume before mixing with BGM/movie audio

ducking.description: Auto-reduce movie audio when TTS is playing

ratio.description: Movie volume ratio during TTS beats (default 0.3)

text.description: Text to be spoken. If empty, the audio is not generated.

texts.description: Manually split texts for captions. Takes precedence over text for caption display.

code.description: The code of the mermaid diagram

appendix.description: The appendix of the mermaid diagram; typically, style information.

script.description: JavaScript code for the beat. Injected as a <script> tag after html. Use for render() function etc.

elements.description: Swipe-style declarative animation elements. Converted to HTML + render() automatically. Use this OR html, not both.

animation.description: Enable frame-based animation (Remotion-style). true for defaults (30fps), or { fps: N } for custom frame rate.

movie.description: Use CDP screencast for real-time recording (experimental, faster). Default: false (frame-by-frame screenshot).

startAt.description: The time to start the voice over the video in seconds.

fps.description: Frame rate of the rendered video. Default: 30.

prompt.description: What the scene shows. Claude Code (claude -p) writes a Remotion component from it.

fps.description: Frame rate of the rendered video. Default: 30.

code.description: A finished Remotion component (TSX that default-exports the scene). It is rendered as is, without claude -p.

duration.description: Duration of the beat. Used only when the text is empty

movieVolume.description: Audio volume of the imported or generated movie

fillOption.description: How to handle aspect ratio differences between image and canvas

firstFrameImageName.description: Reference an imageRefs key for the first frame (image-to-video input), or '$beatImage' for the beat's own generated image

lastFrameImageName.description: Reference an imageRefs key for the last frame (image-to-video interpolation), or '$beatImage' for the beat's own generated image

frameFillColor.description: Fill color used when padding firstFrame/lastFrame reference images to the canvas aspect ratio (e.g. '#F7F6F4'). Default: black

referenceImages.description: Style/asset reference images (Veo 3.1). Mutually exclusive with imageName/lastFrameImageName

generateAudio.description: Request audio generation in the video (model-dependent)

speed.description: Speed of the video. 1.0 is normal speed. 0.5 is half speed. 2.0 is double speed.

x.description: Horizontal centre of the avatar, % of the canvas width. Default 84%

y.description: Bottom edge of the avatar, % of the canvas height. Default 100%

scale.description: Height of the avatar, % of the canvas height. Default 62%

emotion.description: The avatar's expression during this beat

motion.description: Motion name, e.g. nod, tilt, think, giggle, surprise

at.description: Words of the beat's text where the motion starts. Default: the start of the beat

hidden.description: Hide the speaker's avatar during this beat

images.description: Beat-local media references. Same schema as imageParams.images. Merged with global refs (local takes precedence).

referenceImage.description: Direct source (path/url/base64) as reference image for generation. Sugar for references[0].source

name.description: An imageRefs key to use as a reference image

source.description: Direct source (path/url) to use as a reference image

label.description: Role of this reference (e.g. 'the firefighter Travis Kane'), injected into the prompt as a preamble

imageName.description: Reference an imageRefs key to use as image-to-video input

enableLipSync.description: Enable lip sync generation for this beat

hidden.description: Hide this beat from the presentation

id.description: Element id. Used as an HTML id and as a CSS selector in the generated animation script, so it must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*.

timing.description: Animation timing [start, end] as ratio 0.0-1.0 of beat duration

delta.description: Distance for vibrate / angle for wiggle

duration.description: Duration of one cycle in seconds
